tool_schemas.name: take_screenshot
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses, when you provide job_id) a URL-to-image conversion job for target_url using the selected render_engine and capture settings, and returns the job record including the resulting image artifact details when available (or the existing job if the idempotency key matches). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if target_url is not a valid URI, any numeric setting is out of range, an enum value is not supported, or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled or not permitted to render. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the API key has no remaining quota, TIMEOUT when timeout_ms is exceeded during rendering, and CONFLICT if job_id is already in use for a different request (different target_url or render options) and therefore cannot be reused.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

target_url.description: The URL of the web page to capture as an image.

render_engine.description: Rendering engine to use for the screenshot.

viewport_width.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels to use when rendering the page.

viewport_height.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels to use when rendering the page.

device_scale_factor.description: Device scale factor (DPR) to apply during rendering.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

wait_until.description: Page lifecycle event to wait for before taking the screenshot.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for navigation/rendering before failing.

job_id.description: Optional idempotency key; if provided, reuse/return the existing job with this id when possible.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided api_key, including key status, assigned limits, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the api_key is missing, malformed, revoked/disabled, or unknown.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

tool_schemas.name: list_screenshot_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists screenshot_jobs visible to the provided api_key, newest-first, with optional filtering by status and time window. Returns a paginated page of job records. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

status.description: Optional filter to only return jobs in this status.

created_after.description: Optional ISO8601 timestamp; only return jobs created at or after this time.

created_before.description: Optional ISO8601 timestamp; only return jobs created at or before this time.

page_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in this page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_screenshot_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single screenshot_jobs record by id, including any associated image_artifacts when available. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked, NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist for this key, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the id is malformed.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_screenshot_job
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a screenshot job. If the job is queued or running, transitions status to cancelled and schedules any partially-written artifacts for deletion. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked, NOT_FOUND if the job is not owned by the key, and CONFLICT_ERROR if the transition is not allowed (e.g., already succeeded/expired).

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason recorded for auditing.

tool_schemas.name: list_image_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists image_artifacts for a given screenshot job, optionally filtered by status and variant. Returns a paginated page of artifact metadata; does not return raw bytes. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked, NOT_FOUND if the job is not owned by the key, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

job_id.description: Screenshot job id whose artifacts will be listed.

status.description: Optional filter to only return artifacts in this status.

page_size.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return in this page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: delete_screenshot_job
tool_schemas.description: Expires (soft-deletes) a screenshot job and transitions it to expired when allowed, also soft-deleting any image_artifacts by setting status='deleted' and deleted_at. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if api_key is invalid/disabled/revoked, NOT_FOUND if the job is not owned by the key, and CONFLICT_ERROR if the transition to expired is not allowed by lifecycle rules.

api_key.description: API key identifier used for authentication and quota enforcement (ULID-style id).

job_id.description: Screenshot job id to expire (soft delete).

cascade.description: When true (default), also soft-delete associated image_artifacts. If false, the request is rejected because artifacts cannot outlive an expired job.

metadata.name: URL to Image Converter
metadata.description: This backend powers a URL-to-image conversion service that generates screenshots of web pages via an API. It stores conversion jobs (requests), the resulting image artifacts, and access/usage controls (API keys and per-key quotas) to protect the renderer and enable operational auditing. Repository:
